item.title: California sues websites that publish blueprints for 3D printer ghost guns
item.description: California law enforcement agencies seize about 11,000 ghost guns every year. The state now is suing websites that help people manufacture untraceable firearms.

item.title: Prep basketball | Arcata girls ‘rocking and rolling’ to Niclai win over Eureka
item.description: "The girls were ready for it," said Arcata Coach Charlie Espinoza. "We've been talking about this moment all week, and they showed up to our walk-through before the game with focus and freedom. They were feeling light, weren't overthinking it, and the minute that ball went up in the air, they were rocking and rolling."

item.title: Prep basketball | Mack boys amp up intensity to best St. Bernard’s in Niclai final
item.description: Defending their Dick Niclai Tournament championship win from last year, the Panthers got 18 points from three different scorers, avenging two regular-season losses to the Crusaders and dealing them just their third setback of the season, 71-53.

item.title: Ordinance to prevent offshore oil work on harbor district land discussed
item.description: The proposed ordinance prevents the use of property owned by the Humboldt Bay Harbor, Recreation and Conservation District for storing, handling or staging oil or gas produced by offshore drilling.

item.title: Union workers plan for strike at Cal Poly Humboldt campus
item.description: This week, Teamsters Local 2010, a group of union members that work in skilled trades at public universities throughout the state, will be on strike. The union, which represents roughly 1,100 workers across 22 California State University campuses, just under 30 at Cal Poly Humboldt, has scheduled a strike from Feb. 17-20.
